entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: We got a really scary request.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: It says "Kill me"...
That sounds serious.
We don't do hits.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: It sounds like he's in a pretty bad[n]spot. The details are pretty ugly,[n]too...

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: I know that! But we can't just[n]ignore it either, can we?

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: The guy's name is[n]Nao Minamoto.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: He lost both his parents really[n]young, and he's had to take care[n]of his little sister ever since.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: He's been working really hard at[n]a part-time job to support them[n]both, but...

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Right now, he hates his sister[n]so much that he can't take it.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: She's his only family, but... he[n]can't control how he feels.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: At some point, he was so mad he[n]shoved her, but she stumbled,[n]and...

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: ...I guess she got hurt really[n]badly.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: It was an unfortunate accident,[n]but he says he can't accept[n]that...
So it's a penance thing?
Is his sister okay?

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Yeah. He wants to be stopped[n]before he kills his family.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: It seems like she's fine.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: He just thinks... There's no[n]guarantee it won't go worse next[n]time. He'd rather just be killed.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: But changing his heart is bound[n]to help somehow, right!?

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: You need to kill off those negative[n]feelings inside of him!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: "Kill me," huh... Talk about a morbid[n]request.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Let's help him before he does something[n]even more drastic!
